verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both crowd the middle column: the date, venue, pills, RSVP button, URL and fine print are stacked tightly with almost no gaps, and the legal text is unreadably small. In both, 'Sunset Sessions' runs almost to the left edge of the canvas and across the edge of the circle, '6 pm' is indented out of line with 'Saturday 21 June', and the QR placeholder is jammed against the phone at the right edge. A spreads its three pills wider than the button with large uneven gaps, so they look scattered; B keeps them as one tight group, which makes it slightly less bad.
